Luxury 2BR + Den Corner Home by ADERA | Courtyard Views | Prime UBC LocationExperience the best of urban living in this stunning 2BR/2BA + Den corner unit built by renowned developer ADERA. The open-concept layout is designed for comfort and style, featuring a modern kitchen with a long stone countertop island, perfect for entertaining. The spacious living room is brightened by large windows, providing tranquil courtyard views. The master suite, with a walk-in closet and ensuite bathroom, is separated from the second bedroom for added privacy. With high quality finishes and a well-planned layout, this home offers a seamless blend of luxury and functionality. Situated in a vibrant, family-friendly neighbourhood, this home is steps away from grocery stores, local boutiques, and trendy restaurants. Fitness enthusiasts will love the proximity to nearby community centers, while families can take comfort in being close to some of the best schools in the area, including UBC and U-Hill Secondary.
